status: controller image published and verified; production upgrade and account recovery require separate verification
authentication: Bearer sudo administrator on every endpoint; no-store responses
database_support: SQLite only; unsupported engines fail closed

apply_body.evidence_sha256: 64 lowercase hex digest of independently verified NEW payment and baseline evidence

preview.eligible_scope: Only structural panel eligibility; external paid-period evidence is mandatory on POST
preview.expected_schema: Same fields as v1 ExpectedSnapshot; initial_reset is null, latest_reset is the sole positive stored reset
preview.history: complete currently stored rows; no synthetic zero row

guards: active, unexpired bounded expire, positive finite quota, month strategy, no next_plan or prior recovery
exactly one positive reset at least 30 days after account creation, not in future; next 30-day reset not yet due
starts_at within 5 minutes of created_at; tolerance alone is NOT evidence of a legitimate NEW purchase
30 days < ends_at - starts_at <= 32 days; floor(ends_at Unix seconds) equals current expire
starts_at <= last_observed_at <= reset_at < ends_at and current UTC < ends_at
current+B strictly below original quota; at/over quota is refused without modifying status, quota or expiry
same identity/history snapshot, monotonic current since preview and expected lifetime=expected current+B
semantics: Website must verify one NEW paid period, initial zero baseline and absence of other authorized quota resets/credits/transfers. Hash is an audit reference, not payment verification by the panel.

Same BEGIN IMMEDIATE and CAS atomic CURRENT+B algorithm as v1. Preserve lifetime, original history, quota, expiry, credentials, status, device settings and node/admin/system totals. No Xray restart or call.
Receipt adds capability=v2, reason and exact paid_period_evidence; other fields match v1. No database migration; same append-only recovery ledger and unique target guard.

Fingerprint=SHA256 of UTF8 JSON {username:<path>,request:<validated request JSON>} with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=true. Includes v2 reason and paid_period_evidence; UUID stays a string.
Identical original UUID/path/body replay returns original receipt even after expiry/deletion. Changed body/path or reason with same UUID returns 409. New UUID cannot recover the same account twice.
v2 receipt GET refuses a v1 receipt with operation_version_mismatch. v1 routes and two-row history rule remain unchanged; capability always identifies the receipt version.
Never blindly retry an uncertain write with a new UUID or updated expected. Query original receipt first; 404 does not rule out an in-flight commit. Keep external write gate closed until reconciled.

Recover first if eligible, then perform separately authorized no_reset handoff with counter/offset reconciliation. Premature no_reset changes identity and causes not_monthly. Do not alter expired/limited accounts to bypass refusal.

errors.409: v1 accounting codes plus paid_period_evidence_mismatch and operation_version_mismatch; ineligible includes blockers
errors.422: wrong reason, missing/extra fields, invalid timestamp/bytes/UUID/digest
errors.503: unsupported_database or database_busy; uncertain writes require original receipt reconciliation
